headline: EU proposes tax on big tech companies
summary: European Council President Antonio Costa presented a new spending proposal that cuts 204,000 million euros from a plan first put forward by the European Commission. The proposal includes a tax on large technology companies.
why: A levy on large technology firms would directly affect the earnings of major global platforms that generate significant revenue in Europe.
original_headline: La UE propone un impuesto a las grandes tecnológicas
